method: Natural-rAF geometry log from ?reproduceR4Geometry=1 lab route. Timestamps are performance.now() from the page clock.
alsoObserved: C mixed bind: new pair textures arrive a few frames after progress reset

nextProgramBind.note: New pair at t≈0 shows Video instantly, then morphs to Games. Matches the owner recording: target → source rollback → previous correct SINGLE returns → new morph.

rootCause: Scene wrote uProgress from session.geometryProgress. After settle, coordinator is settled/progress=1/activeTransition=null, but session.commitTransition zeros geometryProgress before React rebinds textures. First paint: old pair textures + uProgress=0 = source endpoint. Later commit binds the new pair at t=0, so the previous correct SINGLE reappears, then morphs.
